responsePromise: We come back to every enquiry within a day, usually the same one.

process.detail: Access, levels, soil and where the sun falls decide most of it. We come and see before anyone draws anything.
You get a plan and a price in writing, with the inclusions spelled out so nothing arrives as a surprise.
We handle the certifier and the paperwork. Pool fencing rules are not optional and we build to them.
Excavation through to water in, then we show you how to run it.

faq.q: How long does a pool take?
faq.a: From the first dig to swimming is usually a few months, and approvals add to the front of that. We give you the real timeline at the quote rather than the one you want to hear.
Almost always, and the pool barrier has to comply before the pool can be filled. We deal with the certifier as part of the job.

faq.q: What is not in the price?
faq.a: We list inclusions and exclusions in writing. Rock, difficult access and retaining are the three things that most often change a number, and we tell you before the work, never after.

faq.q: Can you do the landscaping too?
faq.a: Yes. Paving, fencing, decking and planting around the pool are part of the same job, which saves you coordinating two trades.
